title: Integrative Bioinformatics and Machine Learning Approaches for Biomarker and Pathway Discovery in Malignant Pleural Mesothelioma.
snippet: Malignant pleural mesothelioma (MPM) is a highly aggressive thoracic cancer with limited treatment options and poor prognosis.
